content: Looking at the performance of the original sentences (“(a) Original samples”), we see that their language is largely fluent and their sentiment is generally consistent to the original examples', although it's worth noting that the review sentiment of imdb400 can be somewhat ambiguous (63% agreement). We think this is due to movie reviews being more descriptive and therefore creating potential ambiguity in their expression of sentiment.
